title: Budibase: Unauthenticated global-admin & database creation via tenant-confusion bypass of the one-time init guard…
description: Budibase versions up to 3.38.1 contain a vulnerability in self-hosted single-tenant deployments where the public bootstrap endpoint POST /api/global/users/init can be exploited after initial provisioning. An attacker can bypass the one-time initialization guard by supplying an arbitrary tenantId, causing the system to create new CouchDB databases and global admin users without authentication or CSRF protection. This allows unauthenticated creation of persistent admin accounts and potentially unlimited databases, leading to resource exhaustion and denial-of-service against the CouchDB datastore.
